page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a decorative headpiece above the title; a woodcut-style initial "B" opening the verse; a partial marginal line at the right edge ("Auster", cut off by the scan edge) in the right margin.

l.i: Quis ominis picum mali, quis noctuam
Vel in trabes omnem furorem effundite,

page.notes: The initial "B" is a large woodcut-style initial, read as "Bericis" in the text; the first letter is likely "H" or "B" and is uncertain: the printed form reads as "B ericis" with an ornamental initial. The word "Auster" at the right edge is cut off by the scan and is a fragment: it is probably the start of a marginal note, not transcribed further. Long s is rendered as s throughout; u/v normalised to the Latin convention in the verse. Several words in the italic verse were read with reduced confidence and may need checking against the original: "Ratesque", "Oscinem", "suscitet", "Quis ominis picum", "Fluctusque", "Vna institutum".
